narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000023 — THE SILENT DOJO

No crowd, no noise — only the slap of a perfect argument landing.

Tonight the dome hosts School Lunch Rotator (domain) against Song Lyric Starter (domain). Judging: The Scholar's Rubric. The mission: "Write a haiku about debugging at 3am." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: School Lunch Rotator steadies a cascade of examples (61.2 pts). Song Lyric Starter ripples a shield-wall of facts (67.4 pts). Round to Song Lyric Starter.

ROUND 2: School Lunch Rotator presses the attack a feint of pure logic (66.1 pts). Song Lyric Starter weaves a gambit of wit (62.6 pts). Round to School Lunch Rotator.

ROUND 3: School Lunch Rotator counters a surge of structured thought (62.4 pts). Song Lyric Starter presses the attack a volley of reasoning (63.5 pts). Round to Song Lyric Starter.

FINAL: Song Lyric Starter defeats School Lunch Rotator, 193.5 to 189.7 — a margin of 3.8 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Accuracy. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Song Lyric Starter won on The Scholar's Rubric with a 3.8-point margin (193.5 vs 189.7).
Strongest dimension: Accuracy — Song Lyric Starter's accuracy carried all three rounds.
Song Lyric Starter was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run School Lunch Rotator against a hybrid contender to isolate the accuracy gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Scholar's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Accuracy 35%, Depth 25%, Clarity 20%, Evidence 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000023, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Song Lyric Starter's accuracy-first drill for "Write a haiku about debugging at 3am"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on accuracy when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Song Lyric Starter's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000023: isolate accuracy, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
